text: True or False: Unlike the set-membership relation ∈, the parthood relation P is transitive — if x is part of y and y is part of z, then x is part of z.
explanation: Transitivity (M3) is an axiom of parthood, whereas ∈ is not transitive: a ∈ {a} and {a} ∈ {{a}}, yet a ∉ {{a}}. So the statement is true, and this contrast is a key structural difference between mereology and set theory.
